sources.title: Rig3R: Rig-Aware Conditioning for Learned 3D Reconstruction
sources.snippet: We present Rig3R, a transformer-based model for multiview 3D reconstruction and pose estimation that introduces rig-aware conditioning and rig discovery. Rig3R is the first method to leverage rig metadata in a learned setting and the first to perform rig structure discovery from completely unconstrained image inputs.
